from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
prod=Path.home()/"prediction_research_prod"
p=prod/"control/control_center/lifecycle_status.json"
cp=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(prod),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
out={"head":cp.stdout.strip(),"exists":p.is_file()}
if p.is_file():
    obj=json.loads(p.read_text())
    out["updated_at"]=obj.get("updated_at")
    out["target"]=(obj.get("model_execution_architecture") or {}).get("target")
    out["candidate_state"]=(obj.get("current_candidate") or {}).get("state")
print("E141_DASH_STATE "+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":")),flush=True)
